test_title: PYST 32: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 19 Feb, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: The position(s) of how many letters will remain unchanged if each of the letters in the word CREATION is arranged in the English alphabetical order?
solution:
Given Word- C R E A T I O N S

After arranging the letters of the given word as they appear in the English alphabet,

A C E I N O R S T

Only 'E' remains at the same position after rearrangement.

Hence, only one letter will remain unchanged.
